unresolved.reason: The current Bahamas MOFA visa-needed and visa-free lists do not directly name Bolivia. No default, omission, portal or third-country-document inference establishes an ordinary Bolivian-passport visitor route or issuance timing.

The current Bahamas MOFA visa-needed list uses the labels Congo and Zaire, not a current Democratic Republic of the Congo ordinary-passport rule. The ambiguity is not normalized from a historic label or portal.

The current Bahamas MOFA visa-needed list names Sudan but not South Sudan, and does not directly establish a South Sudan ordinary-passport visitor route or actual issuance timing. No omission inference is made.
